findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no paper towels at the hand washing sink. CORRECTED- the person in charge (PIC) produced paper towels. Ensure hand washing sinks are designated as hand washing sinks with signage (provided during today’s inspection), and always stocked with warm running water, soap, and paper towels. Ensure sink on the left is designated as a hand washing sinks.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. [Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the baffles of the ice machine to contain a significant amount of soil debris. Food contact surfaces should be maintained clean to sight and touch to prevent the contamination of food and drinks. Inspector will return on 10/27/25. Ensure the ice machine is emptied, cleaned, and sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure.
findings.comment: The right-hand faucet at the facility’s 4 part sink at the bar was observed to be only dispensing hot water. PIC stated they know to add cold water from the faucet that dispenses cold water into the sanitizer sink, and let it cool before adding sanitizer tablets. This does not account for busy periods, during which sanitizer must be available. Water heater and plumbing should be inspected and repaired by 10/27/25 by a licensed plumber to ensure cooler water is available to maintain sanitizer concentration for food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 5-104.11 System. Water shall be received from the source through the use of: (A) An APPROVED public water main; or (B) One or more of the following that shall be constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW:  (1) Nonpublic water main, water pumps, pipes, hoses, connections, and other appurtenances, (2) Water transport vehicles, or (3) Water containers. [Pf]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: Inspector observed a strainer and lemon in the handwashing sink- indicating that it’s being used as a dump sink. CORRECTED- the strainer was moved. Cease this practice. Rinse sink may be emptied and used for this purpose, or the facility can use a bucket. Hand washing sinks should be used for handwashing only. A blocked hand washing sink is likely to deter hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. [Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed multiple food contact surfaces soiled with debris:
1) The front baffles of the ice machine
2) The holder for both soda nozzles at the bar. CORRECTED- the person in charge (PIC) cleaned and sanitized both soda gun holders. Ensure all food contact surfaces are maintained clean to sight and touch.
- A follow up will occur on 10/15 to check the ice machine.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the sanitizer compartment of the bar’s triple sink to be measuring at 100 ppm quaternary ammonia (quat). CORRECTED- PIC remade sink to a concentration of 200 ppm. Ensure sanitizer solution is made at a frequency to maintain the concentration of sanitizer as recommended by the manufacturer's label. Until violation #50 is corrected, let the sanitizer water cool before adding quat tablets.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions. [P]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an accumulation of food debris and splash on the interior sides and top of the facility’s microwave. Nonfood contact surfaces can serve as a source of contamination for ready to eat foods. Ensure nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency to prevent the accumulation of food debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure.
findings.comment: After observing a hot water temperature at the sanitizing sink, the inspector noted the cold water faucet on the right hand side of the bar’s triple sink to not be dispensing cold water. The water in the rinse and sanitize basins was probed at 140F and 132F respectively. Skin submerged in water that is 132F+ could cause a 3rd degree burn within 15 seconds, and water that is 140F+ could cause 3rd degree burn within 5 seconds. The lack of cold water poses a safety risk to food handlers. The high water temperature also increases the rate at which sanitizer dissipates, making it harder for sanitizing solution to hold a proper concentration of 200-400 ppm quaternary ammonia. A follow up will occur on 10/15/25 to ensure the water heater and plumbing have been inspected and repaired by a LICENSED plumber.
findings.citation_text: 5-104.11 System. Water shall be received from the source through the use of: (A) An APPROVED public water main; or (B) One or more of the following that shall be constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW:  (1) Nonpublic water main, water pumps, pipes, hoses, connections, and other appurtenances, (2) Water transport vehicles, or (3) Water containers. [Pf]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Multiple surfaces in the kitchen were observed to contain gaps and exposed bare wood:
1) The East wall has no dry wall, and is entirely made of exposed bare wood. 
2) There is a gap between the North and East walls (next to the light switch). 
3) The West side of the bar (under the counter) contains bare wood. 
Paint or seal these areas to prevent the entry and harborage of microorganisms, which may contaminate food. Nonfood contact surfaces should be smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: Gaps between the wall and coving exist on the Southern wall of the kitchen. There is NO coving on either the North or West walls of the kitchen. Reseal and provide coving/ trim to these areas to prevent the growth and harborage of mold by next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.13(A) Floor and Wall Junctures, Coved, and Enclosed or Sealed. (A) In FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS in which cleaning methods other than water flushing are used for cleaning floors, the floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1 mm (one thirty-second inch). [C]
